Michal Danielewicz and Jens Larsson outside the office at Sankt Peders Stræde, Copenhagen

### Jens Larsson

er of St. Petri Capital and Portfolio Manager of St. Petri L/S. He was Chief Portfolio Manager of the thematic European Equity Absolute fund at Danske Capital (2007–2017), headed the European equity team at Nordea Investment Management (2004–2007) and was a founding partner of SEB Asset Management in Copenhagen.
